verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway with an admin UI, so an in-product AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in assistant users can delegate tasks to. The MCP Gateway, the admin UI and per-user memory are routing and infrastructure building blocks for other people's agents, not an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
